# Make Position Weights Matrix

```{r}
#pfm <- getMatrixByID(JASPAR2020, "MA0471.1") #E246
#pfm <- getMatrixByID(JASPAR2020, "MA1638.1") #HAND2
pfm <- getMatrixByID(JASPAR2020, "MA1638.1") #NR2C1
#pfm <- getMatrixByID(JASPAR2020, "MA0137.2")
pwm <- toPWM(pfm)
pwm <- as.matrix(pwm)
```

This can be used as a scoring system match motifs to a reference file:

# Finding Positions

```{r}
setwd("~/Documents/GitHub/MotifAnalysisHCMV")
reverse = TRUE 
phylo = TRUE
gapless = FALSE
if(phylo == TRUE){
  seqs <- readDNAStringSet("fasta/Full_cmv_259sequences_Aln.fasta")
}else{
  seqs <- readDNAStringSet("hcmv15-hcmv1b-1.fasta")
}
if(gapless==TRUE){
  gapless_seqs <- DNAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(seqs))) 
}else{
  gapless_seqs <- seqs
}
if(reverse == FALSE){
  gapless_seqs = reverseComplement(gapless_seqs)
}
matched_peaks <- lapply(gapless_seqs, function(x) suppressWarnings(matchPWM(pwm, x, "45%"))) #This is similar to a for loop, when you want to just repeats a single function over and over
matched_motifs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(matched_peaks), function(i) {
  starts <- start(matched_peaks[[i]])
  if (length(starts) == 0) return(NULL)
  seqname <- names(gapless_seqs)[i]
  motif_length <- ncol(pwm)
  motifs <- sapply(starts, function(pos) as.character(subseq(gapless_seqs[[i]], pos, pos + motif_length - 1)))
  scores <- sapply(seq_along(starts), function(j) {
  PWMscoreStartingAt(pwm, gapless_seqs[[i]], starts[j])
    })
data.frame(
    Sequence = seqname,
    Start = starts,
    Motif = motifs,
    Score = scores,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
#count_peaks <- lapply(gapless_seqs, function(x) suppressWarnings(countPWM(pwm, x, "45%")))
ggplot(matched_motifs, aes(x = Start, y = Sequence, color = Score)) +

  # motif bars
  geom_tile(height = 0.8, width = 20) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "pink",
    high = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Position in Sequence",
    y = "Sequence",
    color = "Strength"
  ) +
  theme(
  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
) +
  xlim(195528,200000)

matched_motifs <- matched_motifs %>% filter(!grepl('-', Motif))
if(phylo==TRUE){
  #matched_motifs <- matched_motifs %>% group_by(Start) %>% filter(n() > 3) #This is a filter step -- messes with Tajima's D but otherwise is useful to find standing variation
  starts <- matched_motifs %>% distinct(Start) 
  for(i in 1:length(starts[[1]])){
    if(i==1){
      motif_seqs <- subseq(gapless_seqs, start = starts[[1]][i], end = starts[[1]][i] + 14)
    }
    else{
      subset <- subseq(gapless_seqs, start = starts[[1]][i], end = starts[[1]][i] + 14)
      motif_seqs <- DNAStringSet(paste0(as.character(motif_seqs), as.character(subset)))
    }
    names(motif_seqs) <- names(gapless_seqs)
  }
}

```

# Visualizing individual STAT1 Sites
```{r}
prepare_motif_matrix <- function(matrix, tbl, start, end){
  df_site = as.data.frame(matrix[,start:end])
  df_site$Population = tbl$V1
  df_site$Sample <- rownames(df_site)
  df_site_filtered <- df_site %>% filter(!grepl('-', V10))
  df_site_filtered <- df_site_filtered %>% filter(Population > 0.9 | Population < 0.1)
  site_melt <- melt(df_site_filtered,id.vars = c("Sample", "Population"))
  site_melt$variable <- as.numeric(substr(site_melt$variable, 2, 999))
  colnames(site_melt) = c("Sample", "Population", "Site", "Nuc")
  return(site_melt)
}

#E2F6
```

# Tajima
```{r}
dnabin_obj <- as.DNAbin(motif_seqs)
tajima.test(dnabin_obj)
```

# Bootstrap the Tajima
```{r}
bootstrap_tajimas = c()
for(i in 1:200){
  x = width(gapless_seqs[1])
  len = length(starts[[1]])
  for(i in 1:len){
    if(i==1){
      starts_bs = sample(1:x, len)
      bootstrap_seqs <- subseq(gapless_seqs, start = starts_bs[i], end =  starts_bs[i] + 14)
    }
    else{
      subset <- subseq(gapless_seqs, start = starts_bs[i], end = starts_bs[i] + 14)
      bootstrap_seqs <- DNAStringSet(paste0(as.character(bootstrap_seqs), as.character(subset)))
    }
    names(bootstrap_seqs) <- names(gapless_seqs)
  }
  dnabin_obj <- as.DNAbin(bootstrap_seqs)
  taj = tajima.test(dnabin_obj)
  bootstrap_tajimas = c(bootstrap_tajimas, taj$D)
}
```

# Plot all STAT1 Sites
```{r}
prepare_motif_matrix_nobounds <- function(matrix, tbl){
  df_site = as.data.frame(matrix)
  df_site$Population = tbl$V1
  df_site$Sample <- rownames(df_site)
  df_site_filtered <- df_site %>% select(where(~ !any(. == "-", na.rm = TRUE)))
  df_site_filtered <- df_site_filtered %>% filter(Population > 0.9 | Population < 0.1)
  site_melt <- melt(df_site_filtered,id.vars = c("Sample", "Population"))
  site_melt$variable <- as.numeric(substr(site_melt$variable, 2, 999))
  site_melt$variable <- dense_rank(site_melt$variable)
  colnames(site_melt) = c("Sample", "Population", "Site", "Nuc")
  return(site_melt)
}
mat_motifs = as.matrix(motif_seqs)
df_matrix = prepare_motif_matrix_nobounds(mat_motifs, tbl)
ggplot(df_matrix, aes(x = Site, y = fct_reorder(Sample, Population),fill = Nuc)) +

  # motif bars
  geom_tile(height = 1, width = 1) +
  scale_fill_discrete(palette = scales::pal_brewer(palette = "div")) +
  labs(
    title = "All Motifs",
    x = "Position",
    y = "Sequence",
    fill = "Nucleotide"
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(
  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
)

mat_cntrl = as.matrix(bootstrap_seqs)
df_matrix = prepare_motif_matrix_nobounds(mat_cntrl, tbl)
ggplot(df_matrix, aes(x = Site, y = fct_reorder(Sample, Population),fill = Nuc)) +

  # motif bars
  geom_tile(height = 1, width = 1) +
  scale_fill_discrete(palette = scales::pal_brewer(palette = "div")) +
  labs(
    title = "Control",
    x = "Position",
    y = "Sequence",
    fill = "Nucleotide"
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(
  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
)
```
